reports.title: National Summary Data Page — Côte d'Ivoire
reports.description: Cote d'Ivoire's National Summary Data Page, published on the OpenData for Africa platform on behalf of ANStat (Agence Nationale de la Statistique), the same institute that publishes the country's IHPC (ci-anstat-ihpc). The page's own text states data on it correspond to the IMF's DSBB and that Cote d'Ivoire participates in the enhanced General Data Dissemination System. The IMF's own dsbb.imf.org endpoint carries no NSDPUrl for e-GDDS participants (unlike SDDS/SDDS Plus), so this anchor is drawn from Cote d'Ivoire's own site rather than the IMF's; the tier sweep (int-imf-tier-sweep-2026-09-07.json) separately confirmed via the IMF's own country endpoint that CI's NSDP was first posted 2017-12-27 and that CI appears in neither the SDDS nor SDDS Plus lists.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated data page, not a discrete-edition publication -- same renderer convention as bw-nsdp, in-nsdp and tz-nsdp (HANDOFF section 7, 2026-08-18): a nominal releases_per_year so the pulse reads as continuous rather than one-off.
